modules.module_title: Selection and Preparation of Raw materials

pcs.pc_description: Identify and select appropriate raw materials such as Cowrie shells, Resin, Mirror, Beads, Pearls, Colourful threads, Fabric, Terracotta beads, Rhinestones, Eye pins, Head pins, Jump rings, Ear wires, Lobster hooks, etc. based on design specifications.
Inspect materials for quality, ensuring no defects in decorative components before use.
Prepare materials by shaping, and organizing components like jump rings, ear wires, and lobster hooks for efficient assembly.
Maintain proper storage and handling techniques to prevent damage to delicate elements like pearls and resin pieces.
Create jewellery designs incorporating selected materials such as colourful threads, fabric, and beads to meet aesthetic and functional requirements.
Use appropriate tools (pliers, cutters, tweezers) for wirework, assembling cowrie shells, and securing components like eye pins and head pins.
Ensure proper alignment and balance in jewellery pieces, maintaining uniformity in handcrafted terracotta bead and mirror work designs.
Follow safety protocols while handling sharp tools and adhesives during jewellery assembly.
Check jewellery for secure fittings, ensuring jump rings, lobster hooks, and ear wires are correctly attached.
Polish and refine surfaces to remove excess adhesive or rough edges, especially in resin and mirror-based designs.
Test durability and wearability by conducting minor stress tests on beadwork and thread-based components.
Ensure final products meet customer expectations and industry standards before packaging and delivery.
Select suitable packaging materials such as fabric pouches, eco-friendly boxes, or velvet-lined cases to protect delicate items like pearls, resin pieces, and mirror work jewellery.
Ensure secure placement of jewellery in packaging to prevent damage, tangling of threads, or scratches on beads and rhinestones.
Attach branding elements such as tags, labels, and care instructions to enhance customer experience and maintain brand identity.
Store packaged jewellery properly before shipment or display, ensuring it remains dust-free and in pristine condition.

pcs.pc_description: Identify potential market trends in fashion jewellery, such as customer preferences for materials like cowrie shells, resin, pearls, and terracotta beads.
Analyze competition and find unique selling points (USP) for handcrafted jewellery.
Develop a business plan outlining product offerings, pricing, and target customers.
Identify funding sources and investment opportunities for scaling up the jewellery business.
Experiment with different materials, designs, and techniques to create innovative jewellery collections.
Ensure quality craftsmanship by selecting durable materials like resin, eye pins, and lobster hooks.
Adapt designs based on seasonal trends, customer preferences, and cultural influences.
Incorporate eco-friendly and sustainable practices in jewellery making, such as using recycled fabric or natural beads (wooden beads).
Develop branding strategies, including logo, packaging, and brand story, to establish a unique identity.
Utilize digital marketing tools such as social media, e-commerce platforms, and influencer collaborations to promote jewellery.
Create a strong online presence through product photography, customer engagement, and regular updates.
Participate in exhibitions, pop-up events, and craft fairs to showcase jewellery collections.
Identify suitable sales channels, including online marketplaces, boutique stores, and direct sales.
Build strong customer relationships by understanding their preferences and offering customization options.
Handle customer queries, feedback, and complaints professionally to build brand loyalty.
Maintain accurate financial records, including expenses, sales, and profits.
Develop cost-effective production techniques to maximize profitability and Plan reinvestment strategies for business growth, such as expanding product lines or improving packaging.
Ensure compliance with local business regulations, taxation, and ethical trade practices.
